maddeler.e:
نقتطع (form VIII)
# نَقْتَطِعُ (naqtaṭiʕu) /naq.ta.tˤi.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# نُقْتَطَعُ (nuqtaṭaʕu) /nuq.ta.tˤa.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# نَقْتَطِعَ (naqtaṭiʕa) /naq.ta.tˤi.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# نُقْتَطَعَ (nuqtaṭaʕa) /nuq.ta.tˤa.ʕ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
